summary: TELUS Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 24, 2026, attaching a June 22 press release announcing a philanthropic gala. The TELUS Friendly Future Foundation raised a record $3 million for youth bursaries and grants. There are no corporate transaction terms, no shareholder vote, no advisor, and no structural mechanics. This is a charitable fundraising event, not a special situation. No equivalent US filing type change; the 6-K reports a routine non-business event.
